title: Vocal Remover & Stem Splitter
description: Splits a song into vocals and instrumental (karaoke), or into vocals, drums, bass and other, with Meta's HT Demucs. Accepts audio or video files. Runs on a CPU runtime (a few minutes per song) and much faster on a GPU.
author: NZAP Labs

params.label: Song (audio or video file)
params.description: Any format ffmpeg reads: mp3, wav, flac, m4a, ogg, mp4, webm…

params.label: Model
params.description: htdemucs_ft is a little cleaner; for four stems it runs four networks, about 4x slower.

params.label: Max minutes
params.description: Refuses longer tracks, so one long file cannot tie up a CPU runtime for an hour. 0 means no limit.
